objects.description:
See me or not
It doesn't matter if you are with me or not
I'm right there
with no emotions
It doesn't matter if you hold me or not
the feeling is right there
and it isn't going anywhere.
It doesn't matter if you love me or not
My heart is in your hand
and I'm not going to let you go
tear me apart into two
or
det me live in your heart to eternity
lost in silence
just with memories
—ZakuraBaka
